plain_english_summary: The LogisticRegression model predicts on-time delivery with 81% accuracy (F1-score). The strongest predictor is delivery_time_min, suggesting operational improvements should focus there first.
top_3_insights: delivery_time_min is the dominant factor in delivery timeliness
Weather delays have a measurable but secondary impact — worth monitoring but not the primary lever
Route efficiency shows potential for optimization — even small gains compound across fleet
confidence_assessment: medium — F1=0.8089 is solid for logistics prediction, but real-world validation needed
regulatory_flags: EU AI Act Article 13: Model decisions must be explainable to affected parties
Feature importance ranking provides basic transparency but may need SHAP values for compliance
recommended_next_experiment: Collect 2 weeks of real operational data and validate model predictions against actual outcomes
